newsitem.title: USA: National TechTeam sets new contracts.
newsitem.headline: National TechTeam sets new contracts.

text.p: National TechTeam Inc said on Monday that it was awarded five new contracts for call centers valued at $7.4 million.

The new contracts, which include post-sales technology support, Internet browser, corporate help desk and pre-sales customer service, follow six contracts worth $20 million announced August 1. Also, the company said it completed its purchase of a minority equity stake in WebCentric Communications Inc. The company did not say how much it paid for the investment in WebCentric, an Omaha, Neb.-based firm that provides Internet-initiated solutions.
